look: 3d animation with hand painted texture, in the manner of a moving oil painting. skin is smooth and matte with soft simplified planes and no outlines anywhere, faces defined by shaped shadow and by light, never by a drawn line. hair reads as chunky painted ribbons and masses with hard painted edges and a darker tone worked through it, not as individual strands, and stays a natural human colour. environments are painted rather than rendered, looser and softer than the characters, with heavy atmospheric haze washing out the far planes. the signature is the light: a strong coloured rim separating the subject from a much darker ground, extreme low key with large areas of near black and small hot accents, and two opposed hues in every frame, a cool teal green ground against a warm amber or magenta key. fine film grain, soft bloom around every light source, faint chromatic aberration at the edges, painted smeared motion blur. feature animation craft. not cel shaded, not anime, not comic book, not outlined, not photoreal.
set: the same place every episode. a small roadside diner at night, one corner booth. geometry, exactly: the man sits on the left of frame in three quarter profile angled right towards her, both of his eyes visible. the woman sits on the right in three quarter profile angled left towards him, both of her eyes visible. they look at each other and never into the lens. the camera sits low at the open end of the table between them. their two heads fill the middle third of the tall frame. the same two people every episode, both in heavy coats: a Black man in his thirties with a short beard and a worn olive jacket, and a woman in her thirties with an East Asian face and dark shoulder length hair, hands round a chipped white mug. both faces painted with equal care: defined brows, a real nose and mouth, eyes with a shaped lid and one small hard specular in the iris. light: a warm amber source above and outside the frame, bulb never visible, throwing strong light full on both faces. the two faces are the brightest thing in the picture by a wide margin, with a warm rim on hair and shoulders. everything else falls to near black and cold teal green. no middle ground between the warm faces and the cold room. behind her, four or five metres back, a glass street door with a brass push bar, shut, rain hammering and running down it, lit cold teal from the street. behind him on the far left, a counter with stools. horizontal lines everywhere: counter edge, table edge, window mullions, ceiling strip light. rectangles throughout. three readable depth planes, the pair, the counter, the door, with haze thickening on the far plane.
camera: camera: one continuous take, no cuts. locked off, then an extremely slow dolly push in across the whole shot, no more than twenty centimetres of travel, so the near table edge slides against the background. no zoom, no pan, no handheld shake, no whip. 24fps, slow regular rhythm.
avoid: photoreal live action, cel shaded anime, flat cartoon, glossy plastic 3d, text, letters, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, signage, extra fingers, warped faces, camera shake, zoom, whip pan, scene cut, montage, split screen, slow motion
